segments.text: Morning everyone. Let's keep it quick. Jonah, do you want to start?
Sure. Yesterday I finished the transcript virtualization, so the sixty minute calls scroll smoothly now even on older laptops.
Today I'm picking up the speaker timeline and the talk time percentages. No blockers right now.
Nice. Sofia?
I shipped the new search ranking to staging. Results now jump straight to the exact moment in the call.
I'm blocked on the production index migration though. I need a thirty minute maintenance window from infra.
I can get you that window. Let me check with the on-call and I'll confirm a slot by end of day.
Thanks Liam, that unblocks me.
Liam, what about you?
I spent yesterday on the upload pipeline. Large files over two hundred megabytes were timing out during transcription.
The fix is to hand Deepgram a signed URL instead of streaming the file through our server. That's in review now.
Great. Any risk we should know about for the Thursday release?
The only risk is the summary regeneration latency on long calls. It's around twenty seconds right now.
We could map reduce by chapter, summarize each chapter in parallel and then merge. That should cut it in half.
Let's go with that. Jonah, can you pair with Liam on it this afternoon?
Yes, I'll block two hours after lunch.
On my side, I'm finishing the share page permissions and I'll write the release notes for Thursday.
Quick question, are we still shipping the Catch me up feature this week or next?
Next week. We decided to keep Thursday focused on search and uploads so we don't overload QA.
Okay, that's everything. Thanks all, have a good one.
